lap_counter:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprites for a retro first-person shooter STARLING'S LAST LAP, a 1980s orbital roller rink converted into lethal night racecourse.
Create one TRANSPARENT sprite sheet, EXACT 8 columns x 6 rows, 2048x1536 requested (equal square cells), with no text captions, no grid, no backdrop or floor shadow, no cell overlap. Same object every cell, same fixed orthographic near-horizontal slight-above camera, same size and anatomy, generous gutters, foot/ground centered x=128 y=240 in a 256-square cell. All details kept complete in frame.
Enemy LAP COUNTER is completely nonhumanoid, an upright forked scoreboard/turnstile apparatus grounded on a THREE-wheel triangular cart base. Two squared burgundy enamel uprights hold a split-flap scoreboard panel suspended with a LARGE empty rectangle underneath. Panel cream face, navy flip-flaps with tiny chunky abstract numeral graphics. A separately mounted token launcher on its anatomical right side is conspicuously divided from main body by empty space; launcher is a broad short circular magazine feeding a narrow rectangular slot, aimed forward, no cannon barrel or gun hand. Deep navy enamel, worn plum body, cream panel, cyan stripe, small coral moving flag. Three small grounded solid teal skate wheels (two front one rear); cable-free clean silhouette, no limbs, human head, eyeballs, demon, skull, horns, organic tissue, glowing central core. Mechanical indicator, not a humanoid robot. Score panel and launcher must remain spatially apart from all views.
Style: expertly painted tactile miniature sprite for retro shooter, broad 24-colour-like planes, dark solid outline, intentional pixel clusters, restrained enamel wear, enough dark mass to work against coloured rink floor. No tiny mechanical texture. Overall body 180pixels tall, widest body135pixels, read at 32-64pixels high.
COLUMNS exact front facing viewer, front-right 45deg, right profile, back-right 45deg, back, back-left 45deg, left profile, front-left 45deg. Anatomical right token launcher consistent from all views.
ROWS: 1 idle/approach A: score plate vertical neutral dash arrangement, launcher partly folded DOWN away from shot axis, all wheels grounded. 2 approach B: turnstile wings tilted a little and score plate swings a few degrees, wheels still grounded no motion blur. 3 HELD TELL: launcher swings forward horizontally, coral flag stands up, score plate locks tilted forward into a chunky numeral8 arrangement; broad fork opens to make aiming gap readable even from rear; no shot particles. 4 RELEASE: launcher kicked slightly back, score panel visibly kicks backwards, flag down, wheels remain grounded; no projectile or flash cloud. 5 RECOVERY: score panel swings down and launcher folds sideways/down, body clearly distinct from active aim. 6 CORPSE: cart grounded, fork folded low, panel collapsed horizontally, launcher inert; no gore, debris clouds or glow.
True alpha transparent background including internal rectangular frame gap. Keep navy and black contours fully opaque. No baked checkerboard. Every column is actual turned geometry, not mirrored asymmetric duplicates.
bumper_hound:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprites for retro FPS STARLING'S LAST LAP, an orbital roller rink converted into lethal night racecourse.
Create a TRANSPARENT production sprite sheet EXACT 8 columns x 6 rows, preferably 2048x1536 with equally sized SQUARE cells, no text, labels or grid, no backdrop, no floor shadows, all objects complete and separated by broad transparent gutters. Same object/proportions every frame, same ortho near-horizontal slightly above camera, same scale, body center x128 and all skate wheels floor at y240 in256squarecell. No independently enlarging smaller poses.
Enemy BUMPER HOUND is a low BROAD OVAL unmanned bumper apparatus grounded on FOUR visibly separated skate wheels. Absolutely no animal anatomy, head, face, legs, eye glow, horn, teeth or organic tissue. A low rounded rectangular dark-navy tray chassis (oval in plan) is encircled by SIX thick segmented worn coral/pink/mint FOAM bumpers with large dark gaps between segments. Front pair is bigger and protrudes as two rectangular blunt foam pads divided by empty gap. Rich burgundy tray underneath, yellow diagonal caution stripe on broad top plane, four small separate cream/teal skate wheels, two each side all on ground. Simple big manufactured parts with tactical silhouette, no cables, cannon, hover thruster, spiked armor, glossy racecar windshield. Wide 180pixels, low100pixels at frontal view, stays low and wide from side/back; unmistakable different body from upright scoreboard enemy.
Style: tactile painted miniature retro shooter sprites, coarse confident 24-colour-like shapes, solid dark contours, large graphic wear planes, legible at32-64pxhigh. Foam matte, wheels hard rubber, one broad bold yellow stripe top, no glowing features or teeny surface noise.
COLUMNS left-to-right front facing viewer, front-right45deg, right profile, back-right45deg, back, back-left45deg, left profile, front-left45deg. Exact eight-direction clockwise turnaround every row.
ROWS top-to-bottom:
1 IDLE/APPROACH A: broad pads relaxed in close perimeter, wheels grounded.
2 APPROACH B: front pads wobble slightly at different height but same core chassis, no jumping/wheel blur.
3 HELD ATTACK TELL: body compresses DOWN, both front pads open widely sideways exposing dark V-gap, remaining foam segments squeeze flat, TWO cream brake-flags rise from back corners, rear wheels plant; broad changed outline readable from front SIDE and REAR, no cloud.
4 RELEASE: front pads thrust forward together into a flatter horizontal wedge, brake flags folded down, body angled a little forward but all wheels grounded; NO speed lines, blur or particles.
5 RECOVERY/BRAKE: front wheels angled out into visible brake stance, front foam pads separate loosely, rear brake flags out horizontally; chassis settles down, no tire smoke.
6 CORPSE: chassis low on ground, four wheels splay sideways inert, foam folds inward, stripe stays identifiable; no debris cloud or gore.
Do not make a dog or crab in costume. A weird automated orbital roller-rink bumper machine with no face. Real alpha transparency, keep black interior contours opaque, no baked checkerboard.
